༄༅/ /nyang gter rta nag yang phyung gi bsnyen yig khrag 'thung dpa' bo'i mgul rgyan bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// nyang gter rta nag yang phyung gi bsnyen yig khrag 'thung dpa' bo'i mgul rgyan bzhugs so//

na mo badz+ra kro dha ya/ mi bzad mthu stobs gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mes// bdud sde'i tshang tshing stug po bsregs nas slar// mchog thun dngos grub dpal gyis rjes skyong ba// dbang chen ha ya grī bas shis pa stsol// gang de'i sgrub thabs rgyud sde'i yang snying gnad// du ma phyung ste nyams len gcig dril ba'i// rta nag drag po'i bsnyen yig gsal bkod pa/ khrag 'thung dpa' bo'i mgul rgyan 'di na spel// de la 'dir mnga' bdag chen po'i gter byon rta mgrin yang phyung nag po'i sgo nas bdag gzhan gyi don sgrub pa la yang*/ rang lus rdo rje'i rdzong du gzhug pa'i go gyon pa dang*/ gzhan dpung bdud sde'i g.yul bcom pa'i mtshon thogs pa gnyis las/ dang po la yang chings gsum ste/ khro chu lta bu'i rdzas dang*/ gnam lcags lta bu'i sngags/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dang gsum las/ skabs 'dir rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la brten nas gnam lcags lta bu'i sngags bzla ba'i lha sngags dbyer med kyi bsnyen sgrub bya tshul la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ yi dam 'di nyid kyi sgo nas dbang thob cing spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig la gnas pa'i sngags pas 'du 'dzi dang rnam g.yeng sogs sgrub pa'i gegs dang bral ba'i dben pa'i gnas su/ zla ba'i cha shas 'phel ba'i gza' skar dge bar/ sgrub pa'i yo byad mthun rkyen gyi 'byor pa thams cad mtshams kyi khongs su gsar 'dzud mi dgos par rgyas par bsags/ grogs dam tshig gtsang la blo mthun zhi dul gyi sems dang ldan pa bsten/ sgrub pa mthar ma phyin bar rkyen dbang du mi 'gro ba'i dam bca' drag po bya/ ༈ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bsnyen sgrub las gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang gi mdun du yi dam 'di nyid kyi bris sku sogs dkon mchog gi rten bkram pa'i mdun du gtsang ma'i stegs la/ yi dam gyi dpal gtor dang*/ mdun du chos skyong gi gtor ma dang sman raka sogs phyi nang gi mchod pa bsham/

rang nyid dkyil 'khor dang zhal sprod kyi tshul du gdan nang tshangs can 'bol zhing bde ba'i 'og tu 'bras sam sa dkar gyis g.yung drung rdo'am g.yam pa la sogs par bris pa bkod/ mdun du rdor dril ḍā ma ru nang mchod me tog rnams rim par bsham/ gzhan yang tshogs kyi yo byad sogs skabs 'dir dgos pa thams cad ma tshang ba med par 'du bya/ de nas nyams len gyi ngo bo ni/ thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor te/ nyin dang po'i dgong thun nas 'go 'dzin pa ste/ thog mar bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas/ brgyud 'debs skyabs sems sngon du song bas/ rta yi nga rgyal brtan pos bzlas pa brgya phrag tsam byas nas/ gzhi bdag dang bgegs la gtor ma byin la gu gul gyis bdug pa dang yungs thun gyis brab pa sogs ting 'dzin sngags rol dang bcas pas nan cher du byas nas/ sgo drung du tho brtsigs pa la rgyal chen tho 'dzug gi cho ga ltar bar chad bsrung ba'i phrin las bcol ba dang brtan bzhugs bya/ nang du log nas mtshams gcod srung 'khor bsgom pa sogs zhib par rgyas thebs par byed cing*/ srung 'khor 'di ni mtshams grol rgyu'i thun tha ma'i tshe ma gtogs mi bsdu zhing thun 'go rnams su yang yang du gsal 'debs pa nan du byas na bar chad kyis mi tshugs so// de nas brda sgo nas bzung sngon 'gro'i chos bcu gcig po thams cad tshang bar byas nas/ dngos gzhi ni/ rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo chos kyi dbyings dngos 'dzin smra brjod kyi mtshan ma dang bral yang*/ rang mdangs 'gag med kyi 'char sgo sgyu 'phrul lha yi rol pa cir yang 'char bas gdod ma nas ye shes kyi 'khor lor gnas pa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐ phaṭa: ces brjod pas sngags kyi sgra gdangs kyi rkyen gyis sad pa las/ skad cig dran rdzogs kyis dam ye dbyer med kyi lha bsgom pa'i 'don dmigs gzhung bzhin la/ khyad par du dbu skra gnam lcags kyi ral pa bsigs pa'i skra gseb nas rang 'dra'i khro chung bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/

bar chad kyi log 'dren dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad de ming yang med par byas nas/ tshur 'dus khro bo'i gur du gyur: de yang srung dang zlog pa dang: bsad pa'i las mdzad khro bo ni: rim pa gsum gyi tshul du bsam: zhes pa ni/ khro bo rnams tshur 'dus te zhal nang du gzigs nas steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad bar med du dkrigs nas srung ba'i las mdzad par bsam pas srung ba/ phyi rol steng 'og bar gsum la khro chung grangs med phyir gzigs nas zlog pa'i las mdzad par bsam pas zlog pa/ de'i phyi rol tu gnam sa lcags bsregs kyi 'khor lo drag po me dpung 'bar ba can g.yas g.yon shugs drag tu 'khor ba las me'i tshwa tshwa nang du 'phros pa dang*/ nang gi srung zlog gi khro bo'i sku las yang sprul khro chung mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa grangs med dang*/ sreg byed 'bar ba'i zhugs phung las me'i tshwa tshwa shugs drag gi 'thor rlung dang bcas pa phyir 'phros pa'i bar du dgra bgegs byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa bsad bcad gtubs shing bsregs gtor byas nas rdul du brlags par bsam pas bsad pa ste gur khang gsum mo// de nas bzlas dmigs ni/ bdag nyid khro bo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du thugs srog ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bo hūm̐ yig mthing nag gzi brjid dang ldan pa lang thabs su gnas pa'i mthar/ rtsa sngags yi ge bcu pa me'i mdog can 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba dang bcas g.yas skor du mgal me'i phreng ba ltar dmar kyi ler 'khor ba'i/ thugs srog sngags phreng las 'od dmar me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba can bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros pas/ rang rgyud la sngon las kyis gnas pa'i sdig sgrib dang 'phral rkyen gnod pa'i nad gdon thams cad bya sgro mes tshig pa ltar bsregs nas/ ba spu'i khung bu nas 'od zer phyir 'phros pas snod bcud ma dag pa'i dngos snang thams cad kyang bsregs nas brten pa snod kyi 'jig rten ye shes kyi me dpung chen po 'bar ba'i dbus su/

g.yo ba bcud kyi sems can thams cad rig rtsal gyi khro bo'i tshogs chen por gyur nas me dang khro tshogs las kyang sngags sgra 'u ru ru sgrog par bsam la/ ma dag 'khrul snang gi gzhi snang grags dran rtog thams cad dag pa ye shes kyi lha sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi rol pa las gzhan du ma gyur pa'i lta ba'i gding dang ldan pa'i lha'i nga rgyal drag po rtse gcig pas/ rtsa sngags 'bru bcu pa nyid bung bas tshang tshol ba ltar di ri ri bzla bar bya ste/ 'di la swa bhā bas stong par sbyong ba dang: lha sa bon las bskyed pa dang: ye shes pa bstim pa dang: dbang bskur zhing rgyas gdab pa rnams ma bshad de: gzhung las: sems nyid skye med stong gsal 'di: ye nas rang bzhin lha yi sku: dam tshig ye shes gnyis med la: bskyed bstim rgyas gdab mi 'tshal te: dran pa tsam gyis rdzogs pa nyid: lta ba gyad kyi lha zhes bya: rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin 'di: srung ba kun gyi mchog yin no: zhes gsungs so// yang gzhan srung ba sogs kyi don du/ sgrub thabs rtsa ba las/ gal te dmigs bya bsrung na ni: lus ngag yid gsum sba ba gces: lus ni srung ba'i gud du sba: ngag ni srog snying bar du sba: yid ni thig le'i dbus su sba: thun mong ma yin khyad par gnad: sus kyang mthong bar mi 'gyur ro: zhes pa ni/ khro bo'i gur khang gi nang du/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i spyi bor slob dpon/ pho rigs g.yas/ mo rigs g.yon/ bu dang chung ma mdun/ nor rdzas rgyab tu gsal/ bsrung bya de rnams kyi mgrin pa nas ngag gi dbang po yi ge āḥyi rnam pa can du bsdus te/ thugs srog gi mdun sngags phreng gi nang ngos srog dang snying po'i bar der āḥyig 'od kyi gong bu'i rnam pa can sba/ bsrung bya'i snying ga nas rnam shes kyi ngo bo nṛ yig ljang gu hūm̐ gi thig le'i nang du nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor gyi dbus su sba ba ni khyad par gyi gnad de/

dmigs bya bsrung ba'i dus ma gtogs mi dgos so// de lta bu'i rtsa sngags nyid ma mtha' na 'bum phrag bcu ma song gi bar du thun thams cad la de kho na nan tan gyis bzla zhing thun bsdu ba na/ thun mtshams gtor ma'i las rim ni/ sha khrag gis brgyan pa'i gtor ma snod gtsang du bshams la/ oṃ brjod pas sogs/ rang gzhung gi byin rlabs mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan bdun gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ dpal rta mgrin nag po la 'khor dregs pa sde brgyad kyi tshogs dang bcas pa byon par bsam la spyan drang ba nas mchod pa yan song ba dang*/ khro bo'i ljags rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bas tshims shing mnyes par bsam la/ rtsa sngags la gtor sngags btags pa gsum mam bdun gyis phul la/ bstod cing phrin las bcol ba song nas/ dbyangs gsal dang yig brgya'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba sid+dhi ku ru swā hā/ zhes btags pa gsum mam bdun bzlas la/ dbang chen 'khor bcas mchod pa yi// sogs dang*/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i sogs rdzogs rim 'od gsal du 'jug cing slar yang thun mtshams kyi lhar ldangs nas dge bsngo shis brjod sogs bya'o// skabs 'dir rgyun gyi dge sbyor dang bza' btung sogs byed/ chos skyong spyi sgos kyi gtor bsngo dang tshogs mchod rnams skabs 'di dang srod thun gyi mjug sogs gang bde la byed/ de nas srod thun ni/ skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa dang*/ mchod pa byin rlabs tsam sngon du 'gro bas/ dngos gzhi la 'jug cing bzlas dmigs dang*/ thun bsdu ba rnams sngar bzhin byas nas chos skyong gtor chog sogs 'dir sbrel lam mi sbrel gang ltar yang*/ mthar rdzogs rim gyi ngang la nyal ba'am yang na snying gar hūm̐ yig mthing gsal dwangs pa gcig la shes pa rtse gcig tu gtad nas nyal ba sogs gang bdes nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la 'jug go

/nangs par tho rangs stong nyid kyi ngang ngam yig 'bru'i rang rtsal las lha skur lam gyis langs nas/ gzhi bgegs kyi gtor ma gtang*/ brgyud 'debs skyabs sems mchod pa byin rlabs sogs sngon du btang nas thun mtshams la thug gi bar sngar gyi dgong thun bzhin dang*/ thun bar 'dir dge sbyor chag med dgos rigs rnams byed/ gnyis pa snga thun/ gsum pa gung thun/ bzhi pa srod thun rnams la sngon 'gro skyabs sems tshogs gsag tsam gyis chog /dngos gzhi'i bzlas dmigs sogs dang thun grol ba'i tshul sngar ltar las khyad par med/ rgyun du srung ma'i gtor chog gi rjes su tshogs mchod bya zhing lhag ma btson du 'dzin pa sogs spyi ltar shes par bya'o// thun gzhung du sngags bzla ba yang sgra drag zhan myur bul sogs skyon bzhi/ gnyid glo lu ba sbrid pa glal ba mchil snabs dor ba bza' btung sogs bar du gcod pa drug ste bzlas pa'i skyon bcu sogs mdor na gsang sngags chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bar ma chod par bzla dgos pa la bar chod pa'i skyon che phra mtha' dag spangs te/ tshul de lta bu'i thun bzhi'i sgo nas/ bsnyen tshad 'bum phrag bcu ma mtha' byas pa'i grangs ji tsam song ba'i 'bum rjes su khri dang khri rjes su stong gis kha bskang grangs longs par bya zhing*/ de dag ni grangs kyi bsnyen pa'i tshul lo// dus kyi bsnyen pa ni/ bsnyen sgrub gnyis ka zla drug ma'i dbang du byas na/ bsnyen pa zla ba gsum du bya'o// mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa ni/ bsnyen sgrub gnyis gang gi dus yin yang dngos nyams rmi lam gang du'ang lha zhal mthong ba/ rta mgo 'tsher ba/ rta skad thos pa/ rang gis rta skad 'byin pa/ rang dang gtor ma rten rdzas gnas khang sgrub chas kyi yo byad sogs la me 'bar zhing dud pa 'thul ba/ me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro zhing tsheg sgra grags pa dang*/ mi nag ral pa can byung ba dang*/ rta nag 'tsher zhing rgyug pa sogs lha 'grub pa'i rtags te/

gzhan phyogs las rgyal ba/ dgra dang byad las rgyal ba'i rtags ni gzhung du gsal/ long ba sprang po mdze pho sogs kyis tshur la rgol ba dang*/ mi nag khros pa dang*/ rta nag gsod pa sogs mtshan ma ngan pa gang dag dang*/ rang gi nyams kyang bying 'thibs su 'gro zhing shes pa dang ting nge 'dzin mi gsal zhing sngags bzla snying mi 'dod pa rnams ni mi gtsang ba'i nyams grib phog nas lha yi dngos grub g.yel ba yin pas tshogs dang skong bshags mnga' gsol yig brgya sogs la 'bad par bya'o// gzhan yang rang gi lus la gdon chen zhugs pa dag 'dul bar 'dod na/ sngon du grangs dus kyi bsnyen pa ci tsam byed pa dag 'gro bar byas nas/ de nas thun gyi las gzhung srong tshul sogs snga ma ji lta ba bzhin gyis bsnyen pa'i bzlas dmigs sngon du 'gro bas bsnyen pa brgya phrag kha shas byas mthar/ dmigs pa ni/ rang gi lte bar raṃ yig dmar po bsam/ de las me 'bar bas lus thams cad bsregs/ rang lus me dpung chen por gyur pa las/ me yi tshwa tshwa raṃ gyis mtshan pa shugs drag por 'phros pas nad dang gdon gyi bdag po log 'dren 'byung po thams cad bya sgro me la bsregs pa ltar thal ba bun gyis btang ba'i me stag gi tshwa tshwa las sngags sgra 'u ru ru sgrog par gyur/ ces pa'i dmigs gnad dang ldan pas rab tu lus kyi nad sel ba'i bar dang*/ dngos su sha 'gul tsha tshag /'bring rmi lam du/ bya dkar/ khyi dkar/ spre'u/ byi la/ sre mang*/ spyang ki /'phar ba sogs gcan gzan gsod pa/ byis pa bud med long sprang ser chags/ bla ma sngags pa/ bon po rnams brdung zhing ded pa/ lha khang lder so bshig pa/ mtsho dang chu mig skam zhing*/ sbal sbrul zos pa rnams gdon thul ba'i rtags dang*/ nya lcong sdom sdig rta bla sbal sbrul grog spur 'bu sbrang srin bu sogs lus las thon pa ni gdon las grol ba'i rtags sogs dang*/ rtags mtshan ma byung yang grangs tshad ni ma mtha' yang 'bum phrag bcu'o// thun grol tshul sogs gzhan snga ma dang 'dra'o// de dag ni bsnyen pa'i tshul lo/

༈ /gnyis pa sgrub pa la 'jug pa ni/ bsnyen pa snga thun la grol ba'i dgong thun nam min yang de nyin ngal gsos te sang gi dgong thun nas 'jug kyang rung bas/ sgrub rten bcas bsham ni/ dkyil 'khor gru gsum nang du dug khrag dang sol bas byug pa mu ran me ri dang bcas pa'am/ min na de 'dra'i ras bris sam ma 'byor na 'bru nag gi tshom bu'i steng du mañji la/ khro lcags zangs kyi snod du gtor ma gter gzhung las zur gsum brjid bag can gsungs 'dug kyang*/ rig 'dzin gong ma'i phyag bzhes ltar na dpal gtor nag po rta mgo ljang gus mtshan pa mdzad pas phyi ma nyid btsan pa ltar la/ mda' rgod sgro mar dar nag la rta mgrin gyi sku bris pa btag /dar ram mthing shog la bzang drug tsan+dan gur gum btsan dug sogs kyis byugs pa'i gzhi la/ gser ram gri khrag mtshal sogs gang 'byor gyis srog 'khor gzhung bzhin bris pa bskyed bstim rab gnas blteb bcing byas pa mda' dar gyi mgul du btags la gtor ma la btsug /gtor ma'i g.yas su tsan+dan gyi ral gri khru gang ba dang*/ g.yon du seng ldeng gi phur pa rta mgo can mtho gang ba rnams bsham/ phyag mtshan gnyis la sgrub sngags bri ba phyag len 'ga' zhig la yod pa mdzad kyang chog /sgrub pa grol khar srog dbang rgyas pa slob ma la bskur ba ltar len na/ lcags kyu dngos sam tsakli bris pa zhig kyang bsham/ dbang so sor mi len na mi dgos/ mdun du chos skyong gi gtor ma dang sman gtor rak+ta/ mthar zhi drag gi chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga sogs mchod gtor gtsang zhing rgyas par bsham/ rang nyid bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas brgyud 'debs skyabs sems tshogs gsag sngon du song nas gzhi bgegs kyi gtor ma btang la mtshams bcad srung 'khor sogs sngar bzhin nan tan tu byed cing*/ gzhan yang sngon 'gro'i chos thams cad tshang bar byas nas/ dngos gzhi bdag mdun mnyam sgrub byed pa'am/

min yang sngar bsnyen pa'i skabs lta bu sngags brjod 'don dmigs kyis bdag bskyed bzlas pa phreng skor tsam byas rjes/ rtsa sngags brjod pa'i rkyen gyis/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal sgrub rdzas dang bcas pa skad cig gis gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du pad nyi'i gdan la mdun bskyed khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin zhes pa nas/ bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rta mgrin nag po la sde brgyad dregs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba spyan drangs par bsam la/ spyan 'dren nas bzung bstod pa'i rjes bar bya/ yang mchod pa'i gong du bzlas pa byed srol yang 'dug /mchod bstod kyi 'phros nas byed pa nyid stabs bde bas bzlas pa la 'jug khar/ ru rak+sha dang thod pa sogs drag po'i bgrang phreng du 'os pa'i rigs gang rung*/ g.yon gyi lag mthil du bskyil te mdo 'dzin steng du yod par byas nas bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las phreng rdog re re bzhin hūm̐ yig las bskyed pa'i rta mgrin nag po'i skur gyur/ rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'i sku badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis med du gyur/ lha 'od du zhu ba las khrag 'dzag pa'i mi mgo'i phreng bar gyur par bsam/ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra bar+dha ye hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces bzlas nas phu 'debs shing dbyangs gsal lan gsum brjod/ bzlas dmigs ni/ ba thag 'khrid pa lta bu ste/ bdag mdun gnyis ka'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ yig mthing nag rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor ba dang*/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags phreng me yi tshwa tshwa dang bcas pa zhal nas thon mdun bskyed kyi zhal du zhugs nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim pas thugs rgyud bskul/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu nas thon mdun bskyed kyi lte ba nas bdag gi lte bar zhugs thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim pas 'gal me ltar 'khor bas/

bdag gzhan gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sngags kyi 'od zer me dpung gi tshwa tshwas bsregs par bsam/ zhes rtsa sngags la spu gri'i las sngags sbrel ba ni sgrub sngags ste me dpung 'bar ba ltar bzla'o// thun grol ba na thun gtor sha khrag gis brgyan pa bshams pa la dmigs bya 'gugs bstim byas pa 'bru gsum gyi byin rlabs sngar ltar la bsdu na phrin las gsol ba tsam mam/ spro na bstod bskul rgyas pa sogs kyi mthar phrin las gsol ba bya zhing gtor ma 'bul/ gzhan bsnyen pa'i skabs dang 'dra/ de nub tshogs mchod sogs rgyas par bya/ srod thun la skyabs sems tshogs gsag tsam sngon du 'gro bas bdag bskyed dmigs bzlas cung zhig sngon du song nas/ mchod rdzas byin rlabs bcas mdun bskyed dmigs bzlas sngar ltar la phreng ba byin rlabs mi dgos/ thun grol tshun sogs dang nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyi bar sngar smos pa rnams bzhin no// tho rangs kyi thun 'gor sngon gtor gnyis ma gtogs pa'i gzhan ma brgyud 'debs skyabs sems tshogs gsag mchod rdzas byin rlabs rnams song nas/ bdag bskyed dmigs bzlas bsdus tsam sngon du btang ngam/ min yang rtsa sngags brjod pa dang mnyam du 'jug pa gcig pas me long gzugs brnyan bzhin bsgrubs kyang chog pas/ gang ltar 'thad pas las gzhung bsrangs nas phreng ba byin rlabs byed de bzlas pa la 'jug nas/ thun gtor 'bul ba dang thun bsdu ba sogs sngar ltar bya/ thun mtshams kyi lhar ldangs nas dge sbyor sogs bya zhing*/ bza' btung la longs spyod/ de nas snga dgong srod gsum gyi thun bcad tshul mdang gi srod thun dang 'dra zhing*/ thor thun ma gtogs gzhan rnams la brgyud 'debs sngon du 'gro bas skyabs sems tshogs gsag mchod rdzas byin rlabs nas/ dngos gzhi'i las gzhung bsrang ba ma gtogs sngon 'gro'i chos gzhan thams cad dang phreng ba byin rlabs rnams mi dgos/

de ltar thun bzhi'i rim pas stan gyi drod ma yal bar/ bskyed rim yang rnam pa gsal ba rnam dag dran pa nga rgyal brtan pa ste mtshan nyid gsum ldan gyi sgo nas skyon bral gyi bzlas pa/ dus bdun phrag gsum las grangs kyi nges pa ma mdzad do/ ༈ /gsum pa las sbyor gyi sngags ni/ sgrub pa'i dus tshang ba'i rjes bdun phrag gcig la bya ste/ thun gcod tshul dang las gzhung srong tshul ni sgrub pa dang khyad med cing bzlas pa'i 'gor/ sgrub sngags brgya rtsa tsam bzlas rjes/ bzlas dmigs kha bsgyur ni/ bdag mdun gnyis ka'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ mthing nag rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor ba dang*/ rang gi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng me yi tshwa tshwa dang bcas pa 'phros/ mdun bskyed la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ sngags kyi me lce drag la rtsubs pa'i rnam pa can phyogs bcur 'phros pa'i 'od zer 'khor rnams la phog pa dang dus mnyam du/ bdag mdun gtso 'khor rnams kyi sku'i cha thams cad nas rang 'dra'i sprul pa mtshon cha thogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas dgra bgegs rnams gar yod pa'i gnas su song nas/ thogs pa med par bkug nas 'bar ba'i mtshon cha rnams kyis dum bur gtubs/ sngags kyi me lces bsregs/ sha khrag lhag ma gtso 'khor thams cad kyis dmar tsi ri ri gsol bar bsam/ zhes me sgyogs 'phangs pa lta bu'i dmigs pa ste/ drag sngags ni yak+sha nag po man chad kyi las sngags rkyang pa ste thog ser 'beb pa ltar bzla'o// de yang drag sngags 'di nyid mang nyung dang dag dang mi dag sna tshogs zhig 'dug kyang*/ sngags them ltar gyi gnad de cung zhig bkrol na/ yi ge bcu pa ni gong gi rtsa sngags yin/ yak+sha nag po man chad ni las sngags gnam lcags spu gri ste/ nṛ tri dgra bgegs kyi bla srog /de la 'gugs gsod bsreg gtor 'joms pa lnga las/ hur thuṃ dzaḥ'agugs pa/ gnod byed ni ming them/

gsod pa la yang gsum ste/ spyi khyad par thun mong las/ mā ra ya ni spyir gsod pa/ rbad sngags brgyad po srog gi sngags te ral gris gsod pa/ tsit+ta zung nas bh+yo'i bar gyi nyi shu rtsa brgyad rbad sngags te lcags kyus gsod pa ste khyad par gyi gsod pa/ srog rtsa chod nas rbad sod kyi bar gyi nyi shu rtsa dgu ni gnyis kas thun mong du gsod pa/ raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ gyis bsreg pa/ u tsa ta yas bskrad cing gtor ba/ phaṭa kyis thams cad 'joms par byed pa ste/ de lta bu'i sngags dmigs dang ldan par bzlas pas nus pa ni/ rno tshad me myur tshad glog rgod tshad thog gtum tshad rbab dang 'dra bas/ tshur la gang gis kyang bzlog tu med cing*/ phar la mi 'joms pa gang yang med pas las sngags gnam lcags spu gri zhes mtshan du gsol ba yin no// las sbyor gyi dmigs pa'i skabs 'dir 'khor sde brgyad dgos pa 'dra zhig byung ba dang*/ 'don bsgom sogs su ni mi 'dug snyam pa'i log rtog bsal ba ni/ gnod sbyin dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs: rang bzhin shugs la 'khor bas na: shin tu rno la myur ba yin: zhes pas/ lha 'di nyid la shugs kyis 'khor bas las sgrub pa shugs bstan gyis dgongs pas zin pa ma gtogs zur du bskyed pa ma gsungs so// yang las sbyor 'di nyid sger du bsgrub byar chun dka' ba'i rigs la las sbyor zur du bsnyen pa bas sgrub pa dang sbrel nas yun bsrings na 'thad pas/ sgrub pa'i dus kyi thun thams cad kyi mjug tu las sbyor gyi dmigs pa dang ldan pas las sngags sbyar ba bzlas nas/ sgrub pa'i dus yun bdun phrag bzhi tsam byas na legs par 'gyur ba yin/ gzhan dus bsnyen zla drug ma tsam yin na bsnyen sgrub so sor zla ba gsum re bya/ 'dir bshad pa'i bsnyen tshad 'bum phrag bcu dang*/ sgrub pa las sbyor dang ma sbrel na bdun phrag gsum/ las sbyor dang sbrel na bdun phrag bzhi ni ma mtha' yin zhing*/

mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa ni rtags yig ltar ro/ ༈ /gsum pa rjes la gnyis las/ dang po dngos grub len pa ni/ de ltar dus grangs mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa gang yin yang sang grol rgyu'i de ring gi dgong thun nas mchod gtor gsar pa bshams shing rnying pa yang kha gso/ thun thams cad la yang rtsa sngags la kā ya wā ka tsit+ta gu ṇa karma sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ zhes btags pa bzla/thun gtor gyi 'phror/ oṃ/ kun tu bzang po sogs kyis dngos grub bskul ba yang byed/ tshogs dang skong bshags mnga' gsol sogs la 'bad/ grol rgyu'i snga thun der chos srung gi gtor chog tshogs skong bshags mnga' gsol sogs rgyas par byed/ lhag ma rnams kyang rab dur khrod dam/ min yang sgrub khang las gom pa bdun cu las mi nye ba'i sar khyer/ chad tho rigs mthun nas 'dzud pa'am ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur/ brtan ma btang zhing sgrub rdzas rnams lhar gsal ba la sman rag gtor mas mchod cing bstod/ nyams chag sbyang phyir yig brgya mang du bzla/ sgrub rdzas so sor dbang len pa slob ma la bya ba ltar gyi dregs pa'i srog dbang gis bya ste/ dbang so so'i dmigs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ hūm̐: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag cag la: zhes par tshig kha bsgyur te sgrub rdzas so so'i dbang len/ de bas bsdu na/ hūm̐/ dam tshig chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ khro bo chen po gshegs su gsol// sprul pa'i khro bo gshegs nas kyang*// rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang*// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi// dbang mchog ma lus bdag la stsol// lus la gzi byin bskyed du gsol// ngag la sngags kyi nus pa stsol// sems la rtogs pa bskyed du gsol// yon tan rtsal chen dbab tu gsol// phrin las drag po sgrol ba'i las// dngos grub ma lus bdag la stsol// ces rtsa sngags la dngos grub kyi sngags sbrel ba bzla zhing*/ sgrub rten lhar gsal ba'i gnas lnga las sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga yi dngos grub kyi rnam pa thams cad 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser ljang ba'i rnam par byon te/

rang gi gnas lnga la thim pas rta mchog he ru ka'i dngos grub mtha' dag rang la thob par bsam la sgrub rdzas thams cad spoms te spyi bor 'jog cing gtor ma dang sgrub rdzas lhar gsal ba 'od du ltem gyis zhu nas rang la thim par bsam la/ gtor ma dam rdzas bdud rtsir mos nas lce thog tu myong bas zag med kyi bdud rtsi cher 'phel bas rtsa khams thams cad gang ste bde chen gyi ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsam la mnyam par gzhag /sku dang srog 'khor lus la bcang zhing rdzas gzhan sgrub rten du bzung*/ mjug chog shis brjod bcas pa gzhung bzhin bya'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa rdzas sgrub dang mtshams kyi rjes rim sogs ni/ de la rdzas sgrub kyi khyad par ni/ bsnyen sgrub thems pa'i sngags pas rdzas gzhung ltar bsags nas/ byugs rdzas phye ma dri chur sbyar la g.yag nag zhur bu'i rwa cor blug /bdug rdzas ril bu byas te shel shing nag po'i par bur dang*/ srung rdzas ril bu gri rkang nang du blugs te/ snod gsum ga ma 'dzom na rdzas gsum la snod gang rung gcig 'dzom na chog /de nyid lhar bskyed de sgrub rten du byed nas rtags mthong gi bar du bsgrub/ rtags mthong nas lha 'od du zhu rdzas la thim pas/ byugs srung gi rdzas ni gnam lcags rdo rje'i go khrab bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba ltar gyur nas gnod byed rnams dpag tshad rgyang grags tshun 'da' mi nus par bsam/ bdug rdzas ni dri tshor ba tsam gyis 'byung po rnams myos shing brgyal te dud sprin gyi gseb nas khro chung dpag med 'phros pas/ bgegs rnams thal bar brlag pa'i nus ldan du bsam/ de dag ni khro chu lta bu'i rdzas te lus la bcangs pa tsam gyis srung ba khyad par ba'o// bsnyen pa grol nas rtsa sngags grangs ci tsam song ba'i bcu cha'i grangs kyi kha bskang zhi ba'i spyin sreg 'grub na rab/ min yang bcu cha'i grangs kyi yig brgyas kha skong bya/

de ltar las rnams mthar phyin nas mtshams grol ba ni/ chos skyong gzhi bdag sogs la gtang rag gi mchod bstod dang*/ khyad par mtshams tho'i ye shes par mchod cing bstod nas gshegs su gsol bar bya/ spyir mtshams kyi skabs shes dgos pa'i gnad ni/ mtshams la 'jug nas ma grol bar kha lag mi bkru /skra sen mi 'breg /mtshams khang der yod pa'i yo byad sgo la mi gtong*/ phyi rol yo byad nang du mi len/ bza' btung sogs kyang gsar byung zhag ma 'das par sgrub khang du btsud pa dang longs spyod mi bya/ mtshams 'og tu 'jug dgos mi dang sman pa yo byad sogs kyang sngar nas dmigs 'og tu tshud par byed/ dmigs 'og tu ma chud pa'i rigs nang du gtan nas mi 'jug /rang gis mi mthong ba dang*/ mis rang mthong ba sogs mtshams bug pa dang ral ba'i rgyur 'gro bas nan tan du 'dzem/ mtshams rgyun ring sogs la gos brje dgos na rang gi nye 'khor du bzhag /thun gseng du 'gro 'chag spyod lam mang po mi byed cing stan gyi drod ma yal bar byed/ me la phu mi byed/ bza' btung gi 'phro gzhan la mi ster/ thun bar du yang lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bzlas pa bya/ legs nyes kyi mtshan ma gang la yang spang blang re dogs kyi 'khu 'khrig ma zhugs par/ gang shar sems kyi 'char sgo las gzhan du med cing sems nyid brjod bral lta ba'i klong du rang babs su bzhag pas bgegs dang bar chad kyi 'tshe ba gtan nas bral lo// de ltar bsgrubs pa las rdo rje theg pa'i las rab 'byams spyi dang*/ khyad par lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid kyi go 'phang mngon du thob nas/ rang lus rdo rje'i go gyon pa yin te/ pha rol dgra bgegs brlag pa'i mtshon thogs pa'i las gzhan zlog bsad mnan gtad 'phang ba/ btso rngo sreg pa/ char dbab cing gcod pa/ ser ba dbab dang srung ba/ smyo 'bog 'dul ba/ mdze dang sri'u gso ba/ dbang du byed pa sogs las phran gang 'dod pa dag thogs med du 'grub pa'i mthu thob pa yin no// rgyal kun gsung gsang sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i gar// bdud dpung ru dra 'joms la ches dpa' ba// rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud lung sgrub thabs sogs// 'bum phrag du ma'i yang bcud pad 'byung gi

/zab don thugs thig chos rgyal khri srong la// lha yi skal bar thob pa'i mnog chos mchog /rta nag yang phyung nag po'i sgrub thabs 'di// pu ri nag por mi 'jig rgyas btab pa// nyang ral nyi ma'i 'od kyis sgo 'byed pa'i// zab chos mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag drod rlangs can// rig 'dzin brgyud pa las 'ong kho bo yi// snying gi bum par 'khyil las thos brtson gyis// nyams blangs bsnyen sgrub go don legs bshad pas// dge bas log 'dren 'khrul gzugs bdud kyi tshogs// mthu stobs drag sngags sbyor bas rab bcom nas// dpa' rtags rta mchog 'bar ba'i gad rgyangs kyis// srid zhi'i khams kun yongs khyab bde legs stsol// ces rta nag yang phyung nag po'i chos skor 'di bod chen gyi ljongs 'dir rdo rje theg pa'i lam la zhugs so cog mtha' dag gis/ bdag gzhan gyi don gang sgrub kyi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi sgom bzlas phyag len gyi rim pa shin tu rtogs sla'i khul du byed nas kun gyi zhal sne la yod pa'i yi dam gcig rgyug ma a pha'i gsol zhal lta bu yin 'dug kyang*/ gang zag dbang po 'bring man chad kyis gnad don ji bzhin mi rtogs 'dug phyir/ gzhung don rtogs byed kyi legs bshad man ngag gnad kyi don 'grel bsnyen yig khrag 'thung dpa' bo'i mgul rgyan zhes pa 'di/ rang nyid kyis brtsam 'dun yod pa'i steng dbu mdzad o rgyan sogs don gnyer can du mas bskul bas kyang dran pa gsos te/ dus mtha'i rdo rje 'dzin pa

zhe chen pa pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis rnam byung sa 'brug chu stod zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi char gter gzhung rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs rnams la gzhir byas/ gzhan dgos rigs rnams tshad thub kyi bsnyen yig sogs la brten nas sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo gsal gyi btsun pa bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal gyis bgyis pa dge bas rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa'i legs tshogs su gyur cig /maṅga laṃ/// /
